Problem Statement
Most Psiog projects use the same set of tools: JIRA, Azure DevOps, test case management tools, 
Git and SharePoint. Yet the performance of Engineers is assessed qualitatively, not from 
measurable data in these platforms. Assessments vary from project to project and are hard to 
compare fairly. What good performance looks like also differs by persona and by offering. On top 
of that, people move between projects and roles within a performance period, which makes a fair
picture harder still.
Business Outcome Desired
A digital package that brings together data from these platforms, including data entered 
manually where a tool can't be integrated. It measures performance in a standard, fair and 
configurable way for each persona, project and offering. The result is an explainable, data-backed
view of performance over any period, which supports rather than replaces qualitative reviews.
Acceptance Criteria
1. Connect: Build connectors to JIRA, Azure DevOps, Git, a test management tool and 
SharePoint, plus import of their exports. Each project's tools and field mappings are 
configurable without code changes. Where a live API is limited or unavailable, a mock service
or sample file may be used instead, designed so a real connection can replace it later.
2. Manual entry and edits: Let users add and edit data on top of what comes from 
integrations or uploads, so a project whose tools can't be integrated can still map the data it 
needs. Manual entries and edits are clearly marked, record who made them and when, and 
never silently overwrite source data.
3. Organisation mapping: Maintain associates, teams, projects and each project's offering, 
along with each associate's role on each project (Engineer, Senior Engineer or Lead) and the 
dates it applies. When someone moves project or role during a period, their activity is 
attributed to the project and role they held at the time.
4. Identity resolution: Link each person's accounts across tools into one profile, with manual 
correction. Report any activity that couldn't be matched to a person.
5. Performance model: Teams design their own approach to defining good and poor 
performance from these tools. It must be configurable (which measures matter and how 
much, for each persona, project and offering) but use one standard method, so results are 
fair and comparable across projects. Teams document the model and the reasoning behind 
it.
6. Fair and explainable: Show how each result was reached. Handle sparse data and partial 
periods on a project. Let managers add context notes (for example leave, onboarding or 
support duty). Never rely on a single activity count, such as commits or lines of code, on its 
own.
7. Reporting: Analyse performance over a chosen time period, with a project in focus (team, 
personas, trends), or with an associate in focus, including every project and role they held in 
the period. All views drill down to the underlying tickets, pull requests, test runs and 
documents.
8. Sync and history: Refresh data on a schedule, pulling only what's new. Keep history for 
trends, and version the model so changes don't rewrite past results.
9. AI insights: Use AI to generate a summary for an Engg or a project in plain-English, and flag
unusual patterns or likely gaming of the metrics.
10. Access: Engineers see only their own data, Leads see their team, and delivery heads see 
everything. One admin manages configuration.
11. Data: It should cover several projects across different offerings, people whose identities 
differ across tools, and people who move project or role mid-period

# Psiog Pulse | Engineering Performance Insights Platform

> **A standard, fair, explainable, and multi-dimensional engineering intelligence platform built from scratch for Psiog.**

---

## 🌟 Overview & Problem Solved

Most engineering projects at Psiog utilize standard toolsets: **JIRA, Azure DevOps, Git, TestRail, and SharePoint**. Yet engineering performance has historically been assessed qualitatively or with fragmented, ad-hoc spreadsheets.

**Psiog Pulse** unifies these data streams into an explainable, data-backed view of engineering performance. It eliminates the single-metric trap (e.g. lines of code or commit counts), dynamically normalizes for tenure changes and approved leave/on-call duties, and provides AI-driven narrative synthesis and anti-gaming protection.

---

## 🚀 Key Features & Acceptance Criteria Coverage

| Criterion | Implementation in Psiog Pulse |
|---|---|
| **1. Connectors & Mappings** | Native connector adapters for **JIRA, Azure DevOps, Git, TestRail, and SharePoint**. Configurable field mapping schema without code changes. Offline file importer (JSON/CSV) for projects without live API access. |
| **2. Manual Entry & Non-Destructive Edits** | Interactive modal to add ad-hoc metrics or overrides (e.g., offline spikes, ADA audits). All manual data is tagged with `[Manual Entry]`, author signature, timestamp, and justification, **never silently overwriting raw source records**. |
| **3. Organisation & Time-Bound Attribution** | Associates, teams, projects, and offerings. Dynamic tenure engine: when an engineer changes project or role mid-period (e.g. Alex Rivera: Senior Eng on FinTech Core Jan-Feb ➔ Lead on HealthCare Portal in March), activities are strictly attributed to the project and role held on that date. |
| **4. Identity Resolution** | Cross-tool alias matching graph linking corporate emails, GitHub handles, JIRA usernames, and ADO UPNs into a unified profile. Includes a dedicated **Unmatched Activity Triage Queue** for orphan commits/tickets. |
| **5. Configurable Performance Model** | Calibrated across 5 dimensions: **Velocity & Delivery (30%), Code Quality (25%), Code Review Rigor (20%), Technical Documentation (15%), Operational Reliability (10%)**. Tailored weights and benchmarks per Persona & Offering with embedded rationale documentation. |
| **6. Fair & Explainable Scoring** | Mathematical Formula Transparency Drawer. Dynamic capacity normalization by active working days. **Manager Context Notes** (leave, on-call duty, onboarding ramp-up) adjust baselines proportionately. Statistical shrinkage for sparse data. |
| **7. Multi-Level Reporting & Drilldown** | Interactive **Executive Overview** (practice health), **Project in Focus** (team distribution, benchmarks), and **Associate in Focus** (tenure timeline, dimensional meters). ## 🏗️ How the 11 Acceptance Criteria Were Implemented

### 1. Connect (Multi-Tool Connectors, Field Mappings & Offline File Import)
- **5 Platform Adapters:** [ConnectorsView.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/views/ConnectorsView.tsx) and [connectorService.ts](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/services/connectorService.ts) provide connectors for **JIRA, Azure DevOps, Git (GitHub/GitLab), TestRail, and SharePoint**.
- **No-Code Field Mapping:** Schema editor lets project leads map upstream custom fields (e.g. `customfield_10024` ➔ `storyPoints`, `Microsoft.VSTS.Common.ClosedDate` ➔ `resolvedAt`) dynamically in the UI without modifying code.
- **Offline File Importer:** Allows dropping/pasting JSON or CSV exports with automatic schema parsing for environments behind strict client firewalls.

### 2. Manual Entry & Non-Destructive Overlays
- **Audit Ledger:** Implemented in [ManualEntryModal.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/common/ManualEntryModal.tsx) and [ManualDataAuditView.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/views/ManualDataAuditView.tsx).
- **Non-Destructive Overlays:** Manual entries (such as offline architecture spikes or manual ADA accessibility audits) are stored as independent audit records tagged with author signature (`enteredBy`), timestamp, and reason. **Raw source records are never silently overwritten or mutated**.

### 3. Organisation & Time-Bound Attribution Mapping
- **Tenure Engine:** Implemented in [attributionEngine.ts](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/services/attributionEngine.ts).
- **Mid-Period Role & Project Moves:** When an associate changes projects or is promoted mid-quarter (e.g., **Alex Rivera**: Senior Engineer on *FinTech Core* until Feb 28 ➔ promoted to Lead on *HealthCare Portal* from March 1st), their commits, tickets, reviews, and SharePoint docs are strictly attributed to the project and role they held at that exact timestamp.

### 4. Identity Resolution & Orphan Activity Triage
- **Account Graph:** Implemented in [identityResolution.ts](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/services/identityResolution.ts) and [IdentityResolutionView.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/views/IdentityResolutionView.tsx).
- Unifies disparate handles (e.g., `alex-rivera-dev` on GitHub, `arivera_jira` on JIRA, `alex.rivera@clienthealth.org` on ADO) with confidence scores.
- **Unmatched Activity Triage Queue:** Detects orphan pull requests, tickets, or test executions that lack an associated engineer profile and provides one-click linking or bot assignment.

### 5. Configurable Performance Model & Documented Rationale
- **5-Dimensional Evaluation:** Built in [defaultModels.ts](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/data/defaultModels.ts) and [ModelBuilderView.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/views/ModelBuilderView.tsx):
  - **Velocity & Delivery** (Story points, merged PRs)
  - **Code Quality & Stability** (Bug leak rate, QA rework bounce count)
  - **Code Review Rigor** (Substantive reviews conducted, comment depth)
  - **Architecture & Documentation** (SharePoint ADRs, tech specs, word counts)
  - **Operational Reliability** (Incident resolution, on-call uptime)
- **Persona & Offering Calibration:** Interactive weight sliders and benchmarks calibrated per persona (Engineer vs Sr. Engineer vs Lead) and practice offering (*Cloud & DevOps, Fullstack, QA Automation, Data & AI*), accompanied by documented strategic rationale.

### 6. Fair & Explainable Scoring
- **Mathematical Formula Transparency:** Interactive [ExplainModal.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/common/ExplainModal.tsx) provides a step-by-step mathematical breakdown from raw counts to weighted score.
- **Fairness Adjustments:** [ContextNoteModal.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/common/ContextNoteModal.tsx) allows leads to attach context notes (e.g., **Alex Rivera's 10 days paternity leave** or **Devon Miller's 24/7 on-call duty**), scaling target quotas so engineers are not penalized for approved leave or production firefighting.
- **Anti-Single-Metric Guardrail:** No single activity count (e.g. commits or LOC) can dominate the evaluation.
- **Sparse Data Handling:** Low-activity sample periods trigger Bayesian shrinkage and confidence interval warnings.

### 7. Multi-Level Reporting & Deep Drilldown
- **Project View:** [ProjectView.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/views/ProjectView.tsx) provides team distribution, persona benchmarks, and direct tabs into underlying work items.
- **Associate View:** [AssociateView.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/views/AssociateView.tsx) visualizes multi-tenure timelines, dimensional progress bars, and deep-dive drilldown tabs to:
  - 🎟️ JIRA & Azure DevOps Tickets (story points, cycle times, rework bounces)
  - 🔀 Git Pull Requests (lines added/deleted, commits, turnaround)
  - 🔍 Code Reviews Conducted (substantive comments vs superficial "+1" filtered)
  - 🧪 QA Test Executions (TestRail automated/manual runs, defect links)
  - 📑 SharePoint Technical Documentation (ADRs, specs, views, word count)

### 8. Incremental Delta Sync & Version History
- **Incremental Engine:** Implemented in [syncService.ts](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/services/syncService.ts). Tracks sync watermarks and pulls only records updated since the last run.
- **Model Versioning:** Historical snapshotting preserves model versions (**v2.1-2026** vs **v1.0-2025**), ensuring past evaluations are never mutated when future benchmarks change.

### 9. AI Insights & Anti-Gaming Anomaly Center
- **Generative Summaries:** Implemented in [aiInsightsEngine.ts](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/services/aiInsightsEngine.ts) and [AIInsightsView.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/views/AIInsightsView.tsx). Generates plain-English performance narratives highlighting achievements, tenure shifts, strengths, and growth recommendations.
- **Anti-Gaming Detection:** [antiGamingEngine.ts](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/services/antiGamingEngine.ts) flags:
  - 🚨 *Micro-commit bursts* (many tiny commits right before sprint end)

  - 🚨 *Superficial code reviews* ("LGTM", "+1" under 6 words)
  - 🚨 *Ticket status churning* (>3 bounce cycles between In Progress and QA)
- **Interactive AI Sandbox:** Built-in conversational console to query cross-project benchmarks or analyze individual role transitions.

### 10. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Role switcher in [Header.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/components/layout/Header.tsx) and navigation guardrails in [App.tsx](file:///C:/Users/vamsikrishna.batchu/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/psiog-engineering-insights/src/App.tsx):

  - **Delivery Head:** Org-wide rollups, practice offering benchmarks, cross-project rankings.
  - **Admin:** Connector configs, field mappings, identity resolution triage, and model versioning.

# Psiog Pulse | Engineering Performance Insights Platform ## Comprehensive Solution Architecture & Implementation Dossier --- ### Executive Summary **Psiog Pulse** is a purpose-built, multi-dimensional engineering performance intelligence platform developed from scratch to address the core problem: > *Engineering performance across JIRA, Azure DevOps, Git, TestRail, and SharePoint is assessed qualitatively and inconsistently across projects, with varying expectations across roles and offerings, and complex mid-period personnel movements.* The system combines data ingestion, non-destructive manual overlays, time-bound attribution, cross-tool identity resolution, balanced scoring models, anti-gaming heuristics, and AI-driven narrative synthesis into an intuitive, dark enterprise dashboard. --- ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph DataSources["1. Multi-Tool Data Ingestion (Criteria 1 & 2)"] JIRA["Atlassian JIRA Cloud
(Tickets, Story Points, Cycles)"] ADO["Azure DevOps
(Boards, Epics, Tasks)"] GIT["GitHub / GitLab
(Commits, PRs, Reviews)"] TR["TestRail / Zephyr
(Test Runs, Automation, Bugs)"] SP["Microsoft SharePoint
(ADRs, Tech Specs, Runbooks)"] IMP["Offline Importer
(JSON / CSV Dropzone)"] MAN["Manual Overlays
(Audit Ledger with Signatures)"] end subgraph Normalization["2. Identity & Attribution Engine (Criteria 3 & 4)"] IR["Identity Resolution Engine
(Fuzzy Match, Handle Aliasing)"] TRIAGE["Orphan Activity Triage Queue"] ATTR["Time-Bound Attribution Engine
(Tenure-Date Activity Partitioning)"] end subgraph Scoring["3. Fair & Explainable Scoring Model (Criteria 5 & 6)"] MODEL["Performance Model Engine
(Configurable Weights by Persona & Offering)"] NORM["Capacity Normalization
(Active Days, Part-time Allocations)"] NOTES["Manager Context Adjustments
(Leave, On-Call, Ramp-up)"] EXPLAIN["Step-by-Step Mathematical Explainability"] end subgraph Intelligence["4. AI & Anti-Gaming Heuristics (Criteria 8 & 9)"] AG["Anti-Gaming Engine
(Micro-commits, Self-approvals, LGTM reviews)"] AI["AI Natural Language Synthesis
(Executive Briefs, Growth Insights, Copilot)"] SYNC["Scheduled Delta Sync
(Watermarks & Version Snapshots)"] end subgraph Presentation["5. Multi-Level Interactive Dashboards (Criteria 7 & 10)"] EXEC["Executive Overview
(Practice Health, Org Index)"] PROJ["Project in Focus
(Velocity Trends, Team Distribution)"] ASSOC["Associate in Focus
(Tenure Timelines, 5D Radar, Deep Drilldowns)"] RBAC["Role-Based Access Control
(Engineer, Lead, Delivery Head, Admin)"] end DataSources --> Normalization Normalization --> Scoring Scoring --> Intelligence Intelligence --> Presentation ``` --- ## 📋 Comprehensive Acceptance Criteria Verification ### 1. Connect - **5 Platform Adapters:** Adapters for JIRA Cloud, Azure DevOps Boards, Git (GitHub/GitLab), TestRail, and SharePoint Knowledge Graph. - **No-Code Schema Mapping:** Project leads can modify field bindings (e.g. mapping `customfield_10024` ➔ `storyPoints` or `System.State` ➔ `status`) dynamically in the UI without code changes. - **Offline Importer:** Robust JSON/CSV parser with sample templates for offline projects behind client firewalls. ### 2. Manual Entry & Edits - **Non-Destructive Overlays:** Manual entries (such as offline architecture spikes, manual accessibility audits, or external code reviews) are stored in an immutable ledger with `enteredBy`, `enteredAt`, `reason`, and `dimension`. - **Integrity Guarantee:** Raw source records are preserved intact. Overlays merge seamlessly at computation time. ### 3. Organisation Mapping & Time-Bound Attribution - **Organizational Hierarchy:** Maintains Associates, Teams, Projects, Practice Offerings, and Role Assignments (*Engineer, Senior Engineer, Lead*). - **Time-Bound Attribution:** When an engineer changes project or role mid-period (e.g., **Alex Rivera** serving as Senior Engineer on *FinTech Core* Jan 1 – Feb 28, then promoted to Lead on *HealthCare Portal* March 1 onward), tickets, PRs, reviews, and test runs are strictly attributed to the project and role held on that date. ### 4. Identity Resolution - **Multi-Tool Alias Graph:** Maps disparate handles (e.g., `alex-rivera-dev` on GitHub, `arivera_jira` on JIRA, `alex.rivera@clienthealth.org` on Azure DevOps) into a single associate profile with confidence scoring. - **Orphan Activity Triage Queue:** Scans for commits or tickets authored by unknown handles and provides one-click linking to known associates. ### 5. Configurable Performance Model - **5 Evaluation Dimensions:** 1. *Velocity & Delivery Throughput* 2. *Code Quality & Rework Stability* 3. *Peer Code Review Rigor* 4. *Architecture & Documentation* 5. *Operational Reliability* - **Persona & Offering Calibration:** Interactive sliders adjust weights per persona (e.g. Leads focus 30% on code reviews and 25% on architecture; Engineers focus 35% on delivery and 30% on quality). - **Documented Rationale:** Embedded Markdown documentation explains the philosophy behind weights and thresholds. ### 6. Fair and Explainable - **Step-by-Step Formula Transparency:** Clickable "Explain Formula" modal breaks down raw metrics, benchmarks, active day scaling factors, category scores, and weighted contributions. - **Capacity Normalization:** Active calendar days and part-time allocations scale monthly target baselines. - **Manager Context Notes:** Approved leave (e.g. 10 days paternity leave) or 24/7 on-call firefighting duty adjust expectations proportionately. - **Anti-Single-Metric Guardrail:** No single metric (such as raw commits or LOC) can dominate performance. ### 7. Reporting & Deep Drilldown - **Reporting Views:** - *Executive Overview:* Cross-project rankings, practice offering health. - *Project View:* Team personas, sprint velocity trends, deliverable breakdown. - *Associate View:* Tenure timeline, 5-dimensional Radar balance chart, appraisal dossier export. - **Underlying Artifact Drilldowns:** Interactive tabs for Tickets (JIRA/ADO), Pull Requests (Git), Reviews (Git), Test Runs (TestRail), and Documents (SharePoint). ### 8. Incremental Delta Sync & History - **Incremental Sync Engine:** Watermark tracking queries only delta changes since the last sync. - **Model Version Snapshots:** Model versions (*v2.1-2026 Active* vs *v1.0-2025 Archived*) ensure historical evaluations are immutable. ### 9.
